theorem_title: Constructing a balanced physical wanted array
theorem_formal_statement:
theorem ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightBalancedWanted.program_meets {μ : ℕ → ℤ} {a b NL NR M free U d : ℕ} [NeZero M]
    (left right : ℕ → ℤ) (hw : (lim.space : ℤ) ≤ lim.word)
    (ha : a+NL ≤ free) (hb : b+NR ≤ free)
    (hspace : _root_.ThreeSum.LightBalancedWanted.space free M left right NL NR U ≤ lim.space)
    (hword : (_root_.ThreeSum.LightBalancedWanted.word M NL NR U : ℤ) ≤ lim.word)
    (hd : d+Nat.clog 2 M+NL+6 ≤ lim.depth)
    (hleft : ∀ i < NL, μ (a+i)=left i) (hright : ∀ j < NR, μ (b+j)=right j)
    (hvaluesL : ∀ i < NL, |left i| ≤ (U : ℤ))
    (hvaluesR : ∀ j < NR, |right j| ≤ (U : ℤ)) :
    _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.Light.Meets lim _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightBalancedWanted.program 25 d [a,b,NL,NR,M,free] μ (_root_.ThreeSum.LightBalancedWanted.time M left right NL NR U)
      (fun r ν => r=(free : ℤ) ∧
        _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightWantedSetup.Output ν free M left right NL NR
          (_root_.ThreeSum.LightOriginalOffset.selected M left right NL NR) ∧
        M*(ν free).toNat ≤ NL*NR ∧ _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.Light.Kept μ ν free) := by sorry
theorem_natural_language_statement:
Let two stored integer source arrays of lengths $N_L,N_R$ be bounded by $U$, with nonzero modulus $M$. Under the declared source protection, space, word, and depth bounds, procedure 25 chooses the deterministic original offset and constructs the exact wanted output at the free base. It returns that base and guarantees $$M\cdot\operatorname{wantedCount}\le N_LN_R,$$ preserving earlier memory within the stated time.

This construction supplies an actual wanted array whose count obeys the selected balancing offset guarantee.
